note: What a server sends to move units. It carries a number a client returns to say it has taken the group in. The header carries zero or names the object this is about, and a client accepts either.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: The number of this statement; a client applies a path to a unit only where it is not behind the last the unit took. A client returns it in WaypointAck to say the group arrived.

fields.name: movementCount
fields.note: How many paths follow, one for each unit. A client reads it as signed, so a count above 32767 counts as none, as zero does, and a client still answers.

fields.name: movements
fields.note: One path for each unit.
